lessons.title: The Five Senses

teach.intro: We use our five senses to learn about the world around us.

questions.prompt: Which body part do you use to smell?
Which body part do you use to hear?
Which body part do you use to see?
Which body part do you use to taste?

lessons.review: Your five senses help you explore and understand everything around you!

lessons.title: Weather & Seasons

teach.intro: Weather changes with the seasons throughout the year.
examples: Fall is when leaves change color

questions.prompt: Which season is usually the hottest?
What falls from clouds when it rains?
Which season do leaves usually fall?
What do you wear outside when it's snowing?

lessons.review: Noticing the weather and seasons helps you know how to dress and plan your day!

lessons.title: Living vs Non-Living

teach.intro: Living things grow, eat, and need air and water. Non-living things don't.

questions.prompt: Which one is living?
Which one is non-living?
Which one needs food and water to grow?
Which one is living?

lessons.review: Knowing the difference between living and non-living helps you understand nature!

lessons.title: Animal Habitats

teach.intro: A habitat is the natural home of an animal, where it finds food, water, and shelter.

questions.prompt: Where does a fish live?
Where does a bird build its nest?
Where does a bear live?
Where does a camel live?

lessons.review: Every animal has a special home that fits exactly what it needs to survive!

lessons.title: What Plants Need

teach.intro: Plants need sunlight, water, air, and soil to grow big and healthy.

questions.prompt: What do plants need to grow, besides water?
Where do plants get water from?
What color are most plant leaves?

lessons.review: Taking care of what plants need helps them grow strong, just like we need food and rest!

lessons.title: Life Cycles

teach.intro: Living things change and grow through stages, called a life cycle.

questions.prompt: What comes after 'egg' for a butterfly?
What comes after 'caterpillar'?
What is the last stage for a butterfly?
What does a frog hatch from?

lessons.review: Life cycles show how living things grow and change over time!

lessons.title: States of Matter

teach.intro: Everything around us is made of matter, and matter can be solid, liquid, or gas.

questions.prompt: Ice is what state of matter?
Water is what state of matter?
Steam is what state of matter?
A rock is a...?

lessons.review: Matter changes state depending on things like heat and cold - like ice melting into water!

lessons.title: Day and Night

teach.intro: The earth spins slowly, which gives us day and night.
examples: We see the sun during the day
We see the moon at night

questions.prompt: What do we see in the sky during the day?
What do we see in the sky at night?
Why do we have day and night?
About how many hours are in a full day?

lessons.review: The spinning earth is why the sun rises and sets every single day!

lessons.title: Amazing Body Parts

teach.intro: Our bodies have parts that all work together to help us live and move.

questions.prompt: Which body part pumps blood?
Which body part helps you breathe?
Which body part helps you think?
Which body parts help you walk?

lessons.review: Every part of your body has an important job to keep you healthy and strong!

lessons.title: Caring for Our Earth

teach.intro: We can help take care of the earth by reducing waste, reusing things, and recycling.
examples: Recycling bottles instead of throwing them away
Planting trees helps clean the air

questions.prompt: What should you do with a plastic bottle instead of throwing it away?
Turning off lights when not in use helps save...?
Picking up litter helps keep our earth...?
Planting trees helps give us more...?

lessons.review: Small actions like recycling and picking up litter add up to a healthier planet!
